company.description:
AppliedAI is a technology company that provides AI-augmented automation for mission-critical business workflows. The company's flagship platform, Opus, enables organizations in regulated sectors—such as banking, healthcare, insurance, and life sciences—to automate back-office and mid-office operations with auditable, compliant AI workflows that include human expert oversight.

The company utilizes a proprietary Large Work Model (LWM) and Work Knowledge Graph (WKG) to encode procedural and operational knowledge, allowing Opus to generate and optimize workflow structures tailored to specific regulatory, accuracy, and process constraints. AppliedAI emphasizes security, traceability, and consistency. Its platform employs human expert verification at key stages, military-grade security practices, and audit trails to maintain compliance and reduce risks.
